summary: The marketing team is juggling multiple high-priority initiatives, with the China Going-Global report and SEO-focused program promotion for Asia Star and Intelligent China leading the charge, while also managing website redesign feedback, translation projects, and operational issues like the Outlook login problem.
summaryDetail: The most critical focus is the joint 'New Chinese Playbook for Going Global' report, which must be ready by early September for Singapore events; a one-pager proposal is due from Felix, and collaboration details with Tech In Asia and EuroCham are being finalized this week. Simultaneously, SEO and program promotion for Asia Star and Intelligent China are top priorities, with Joseph working on target area drafts and conversion tracking setup, and the team analyzing participant data to refine audience profiles. The website redesign is in feedback phase—Joseph's design needs input, and decisions on menu alignment and index incorporation are pending, while the team also needs to review AI-generated meta-descriptions for over 1,000 pages by end of July. Translation of the IE report is underway, with a cap at 50%, and the team is expediting social media agency selection. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook login issue affecting all devices, and ensure all action items from recent meetings are progressing, including brochure updates and press release adjustments.
